activeDesignerRulings.authority: Explicit designer correction 2026-11-01; supersedes only MANA BURN handling from v1.1.1
activeDesignerRulings.effect_only_card: If a card has only MANA BURN and the opponent Mana Pool has zero Mana cards at the relevant play-declaration time, the card is unplayable. If opponent has one or more Mana cards, it may be played even if fewer than X (burn up to X). Timing-dependent cards with future triggers should not be restricted in advance based only on current Mana.
activeDesignerRulings.mana_burn: MANA BURN X means remove UP TO X physical Mana Cards from the opponent Mana Pool, returning the removed cards to their Mana Deck. Burn count is min(X, the number of physical Mana cards currently in the target Mana Pool). If target Mana Pool has zero cards, MANA BURN does not occur. No exact-X resource requirement.
activeDesignerRulings.mana_steal: Refer to D-2026-11-01-MANA-STEAL-UP-TO-X, now also up-to X.
activeDesignerRulings.secondary_effect: An Attack with damage plus MANA BURN proceeds with damage. When target has fewer than X Mana, MANA BURN removes only those remaining; when target has zero Mana, skip Burn but keep damage.
activeDesignerRulings.trigger_order: Separate simultaneous-trigger ordering issues remain pending unless already specified in card or other official rules.

activeDesignerRulings.rule: MANA STEAL X resolves UP TO X with one-for-one removal from opponent Mana Pool and Mana draw from own Mana Deck, capped by room in own Mana Pool (maximum 12). Amount = min(X, opponentPoolCount, ownManaDeckCount, 12-ownManaPoolCount). When zero no Steal. A pure immediate Steal-only card cannot be played if its sole effect cannot occur; when secondary, independently valid damage or effects still resolve.
activeDesignerRulings.step_order: Remove the actual bounded count of opponent physical Mana cards from their Mana Pool back to their Mana Deck; only AFTER that, draw exactly the same number of cards from own Mana Deck into own Mana Pool. Do not transfer opponent physical Mana cards to the acting player.

activeDesignerRulings.automatic_center: Mandatory automatic Center overrides Freeze/Stun restriction on manually selected Swap.
activeDesignerRulings.draw_start_casting_order: No gameplay-relevant choice or change to Casting counter timing currently depends on internal order, so do not add a player priority rule.
activeDesignerRulings.hit_effect_gate: IF THIS ATTACK HITS requires a confirmed Hit; never activate before checking Hit.
activeDesignerRulings.mana_burn_order: Designer-confirmed Area Attack: ONE Attack action; resolve all first-effect damage/Hit results; count all connected Hits; THEN execute the secondary per-hit MANA BURN as a single aggregated removal (up to available Mana). Avoid per-target independent Burn during damage.
activeDesignerRulings.mana_regen: Regen up to printed amount, bounded by own Mana Deck cards and Mana Pool capacity 12.
activeDesignerRulings.reflect: REFLECT only when the incoming Attack hits. DODGE/NEGATE prevent it. BLOCK or accepting a connected Attack may enable it.
activeDesignerRulings.simultaneous_defeat: DRAW for simultaneous final Hero Defeat in the same Attack/Defense exchange, not a universal ruling for unrelated causes.

activeDesignerRulings.area_burn: For a single Area Attack dealing damage as its first effect and MANA BURN 1 for each Attack Hit as its second effect: apply all Attack damage first, determine connected Hit count across targets, then remove UP TO that many opponent physical Mana cards ONCE, capped by opponent remaining Mana Pool. One card action, one aggregate secondary effect; Dodge/Negate produce no Hit, while a connected Hit at 0 damage still counts.
activeDesignerRulings.limits: Does not silently redefine unrelated card-specific timing or exception rules.
activeDesignerRulings.mana_steal: For MANA STEAL 2 against opponent Mana Pool containing 1 physical Mana card: remove 1 opponent Mana card (to their Mana Deck); THEN draw exactly 1 physical Mana card from own Mana Deck. MANA STEAL X is UP TO X. The opponent Mana is not transferred into the acting player Mana Pool.

activeDesignerRulings.invalid_test_state: A test which truncates Mana Pool or Deck without moving those physical cards into the other zone does NOT represent an authentic playable game state. Such tests may be diagnostic only and cannot be the basis for claiming an ordinary resource shortage.
activeDesignerRulings.mana_burn: MANA BURN X removes up to X physical opponent cards to the opponent Mana Deck, never more than present. Secondary per-Hit Area Burn is one aggregate second effect after all first-effect damages.
activeDesignerRulings.mana_steal: MANA STEAL X is up to X. Remove min(X, available opponent Mana) physical opponent cards into their own Mana Deck, then draw exactly the same number from your own Mana Deck into your Mana Pool (subject to the unbreakable 12-card invariant). A pure zero-cost Steal cannot be played when it could perform zero Steal; an Attack with secondary Steal still resolves its damage when Steal is zero.
activeDesignerRulings.physical_resource_invariant: For each player, Mana Deck + Mana Pool always contain exactly 12 owned physical Mana cards. Mana Pool may contain 0 through 12 cards; Mana Deck holds the remainder. Effects move physical Mana between these two zones; they do not create/delete Mana.
